note: Frozen evaluation criteria for future METARGON research (v0.13) and Academy Memory (v0.6) PRs. Defined by the independent audit BEFORE inspecting any v0.13 / v0.6 result, and before those experiments exist. Any deviation must be documented with justification in the PR. Criteria v01 (audit v0.3) remains in force for v0.12.1 / Academy v0.5 retrospective checks; this v02 file replaces it for all new research claims.

mechanism_lab_v013.minimum: >=4 seeds x 40 episodes per family-condition cell (preliminary/pilot only)
mechanism_lab_v013.confirmatory: >=8 seeds x 100 episodes per family-condition cell for any population-level claim
mechanism_lab_v013.registration: Pilot thresholds, conditions, families, and policy roster must be recorded BEFORE running; post-hoc expansion must be declared.
mechanism_lab_v013.note: The committed v0.12 / v0.12.1 studies are 4x40 and are therefore pilot-grade; any headline claim carried into docs must either upgrade to 8x100 or be explicitly labeled preliminary.

academy_memory_v06.minimum: 2 train seeds x full frozen grid (16 classic / 12 OOD / 6 continual)
academy_memory_v06.confirmatory: >=5 train seeds x full frozen grid for any transfer/retention claim

requirement: Every headline metric must be reported as a per-seed vector in the artifact (not only the mean).
Report population stddev, min/max, and the count of seeds with nonzero/positive evidence for every discovery metric (exact D1/D2).
All paired deltas use candidate - baseline (audit v0.2 convention).
Paired bootstrap 95% CIs must be reported for every delta claimed as an effect; attach the raw vectors.
If the CI includes 0, the claim must be worded as 'no measured effect', not as improvement.
Any claim must state how many seeds drive it; a mean driven by <=2 seeds of 8 is not a robust population effect.
Report separately: (1) zero-shot/frozen score (learning disabled during evaluation), (2) within-episode-learning score.
Transfer/retention claims must use the zero-shot score.
Within-episode learning must be reported as a separate quantity: adapt - frozen.
Fresh controls must be run under the same within-episode protocol.
A memory claim that appears only in the within-episode regime is a within-episode-learning claim, not a transfer claim.
Identical per-decision budgets (plan expansion cap, memory bounds, action horizon) across compared policies.
If a baseline uses a larger budget, compare only with a compute-capped variant or report CPU seconds alongside; never compare raw success without both.
Report invalid-action counts per policy (they are a policy cost).
All policies in a comparison must receive the same episode streams (matched seeds) and the same max_steps per condition.
For every proposed change, rerun the matched-seed regression suite before merge: families F (5 conditions), H (stable/novel), R (stable/novel), L (stable/novel), plus the Academy frozen grid.
A family-agnostic change may not reduce any prior headline metric (success or exact D1/D2) beyond the paired-bootstrap noise bound (delta CI must include 0 or decline < 2 SE).
Any regression beyond noise must be acknowledged in the report with the changed cells, and the change must not be merged silently.
Exact-discovery metrics (D1/D2) must be tracked per family; losing a discovery capability is a regression even if success is unchanged.
Record the exact committed baseline artifacts compared against and the git state of the harness.
A claim of improvement requires ALL of:
(a) confirmatory sample size (8x100 mechanism lab / >=5 train seeds Academy);
(b) candidate - baseline paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding 0, or effect size declared a priori;
(c) per-seed breakdown showing the effect is not carried by one seed;
(d) a mechanism check: ablation or controlled control showing the named mechanism is the cause;
(e) reproducible commands recorded in the report (exact CLI, PYTHONHASHSEED, code state);
(f) no unpreserved regression in the preservation suite.
Pilot results (4x40 / 2 train seeds) may be reported but must be labeled preliminary and must not be used as the basis of a population claim.
Evaluation protocol is defined by the independent audit and is implementation-agnostic.
The researchers' own evaluation runs are not admissible as the sole evidence for a claim; at least one independent recomputation (audit rerun) is required for any headline figure.
Artifacts must be committed raw (per-seed) alongside summaries; summaries computable from raw must match.
